easy.def: To look at something very closely.
examples: The doctor will examine my ear.
I examine the bug with my eyes.
The vet examines our dog.

more.def: To look at or check something carefully to learn more about it.
examples: We examined the leaf under a magnifying glass.
The detective examined the room for clues.
She examined the coin closely to read its date.
I was exhausted after the long walk.
The exhausted baby fell asleep.
We were exhausted after the swim.

more.def: Extremely tired, with no energy left.
examples: After the race, the exhausted runners lay down on the grass.
The exhausted hikers finally reached their camp.
I was exhausted from staying up too late.

easy.def: A test to find out something.
examples: We did an experiment with ice and salt.
In our experiment, the egg floated.
The experiment made bubbles.

more.def: A careful test done to discover or prove something.
examples: Our science experiment showed that plants grow toward light.
The scientist repeated the experiment to check her results.
As an experiment, we tried baking the bread without sugar.

easy.def: To look around a new place.
examples: Let's explore the garden!
We explore the beach for shells.
The cat explores the new house.

more.def: To travel through or look carefully at a place to learn about it.
examples: The divers explored a cave deep under the sea.
Robots explore the surface of Mars.
On vacation, we explored the old part of the city.

easy.def: No longer living anywhere on Earth.
examples: Dinosaurs are extinct.
Some animals may go extinct.
The extinct bird had a big beak.

more.def: No longer existing; having no living members left.
examples: The dodo bird became extinct hundreds of years ago.
Woolly mammoths have been extinct for thousands of years.
People are working to keep tigers from becoming extinct.
